response.justification: Despite extensive experience as a senior software developer, the candidate lacks Java-specific project depth, has only basic German proficiency (a hard requirement), and holds a senior title inconsistent with an entry-level role, raising concerns about fit, salary expectations, and language compliance.
strengths: Extensive full-stack development experience across multiple languages and domains
Strong contributions to open-source and community education initiatives
Demonstrated proficiency in agile practices, CI/CD, and test-driven development
concerns: German language skill is only basic, not meeting required fluency
Overqualified with senior titles and 10+ years of experience for an entry-level role
Java is listed as a skill but not used in recent roles; no clear insurance sector exposure
